import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')

# Convert '年月' to datetime format
df['年月'] = pd.to_datetime(df['年月'])

# Group by '年月' and calculate the average waiting time
grouped_df = df.groupby('年月')['平均待ち時間'].mean()

# Plot the grouped data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
grouped_df.plot(kind='bar', color='skyblue')
plt.title('年月ごとの平均待ち時間折れ線グラフ')
plt.xlabel('年月')
plt.ylabel('平均待ち時間 (分)')
plt.ylim(60, 0)
plt.legend()
plt.show()
